feeds.title: Life Part 2 & Beyond Blog
feeds.description: In 2011 Jonathan Look sold everything he owned, took early retirement and began travelling the world. He started this blog to demonstrate to his fellow baby boomers that the world is not some scary place and it is still open and available to those who are motivated and curious enough to go out and see it for themselves.

feeds.title: Retired And Travelling
feeds.description: Linda and David are travel bloggers and photographers - semi retired and travelling everywhere around the world. Having visited over 100 countries, we are sure to have some travel inspiration and great travel tips for you! Retired and Travelling gives us opportunities for scuba diving, luxury cruising, indulging our chocoholic needs, and appeasing our sea and sunshine addictions.

feeds.title: Travel Past 50 Blog
feeds.description: We're Kristin Henning and Tom Bartel. In 2010, we sold our business, our home, our possessions, and gave away our dog.We've been traveling the world ever since. Travel Past 50 offers encouragement, entertainment, and information, with sharp writing, personal tales, and professional photography, for travelers over the age of 50.

feeds.title: One Road at a Time
feeds.description: We are Patti and Abi. After retiring early to live a simpler life, travel the world, and hopefully, inspire others to redefine retirement. We've been traveling through life together for 40+ years, embracing each new chapter and each new adventure with open minds. Our travels have taken us to four continents and to 19 countries. In their blog, they give travel tips for different countries and information about different locations.

feeds.title: Always and Forever reidchampagne.com Home
feeds.description: A blog about widower septuagenarian charting his travels through around the globe.

feeds.title: Off to See the Country
feeds.description: A running account of our retirement activities. Have fun viewing.

feeds.title: Adventure And Retire
feeds.description: I want to show you that you can travel on a budget without breaking the bank and at the same time enjoying your trip. Hopefully, it will inspire you to travel too and show you that the world is not a scary place to avoid. The whole point of this blog is to inspire you to travel and see the world.

feeds.title: Seniors with Latitude
feeds.description: Aloha! Jack and Elaine here - we are two adventurous seniors with an unquenchable thirst for travel. We've been travelling internationally since 2013, long before we started this blog. We share inspiration & resources for the senior traveller. We are your global lifestyle specialists helping you travel longer, for less and have more fun doing it.

feeds.title: What's in Dave's Head
feeds.description: Reflections and tips on the adventures and trips of recent retirees Dave and Donna.

feeds.title: Retire Early And Travel
feeds.description: Retire Early and Travel is a website dedicated to showing you how to retire early, live abroad and travel the world. Live life!

feeds.title: Early Retirement Now » Travel
feeds.description: You can't afford not to retire early!

feeds.title: I'm Retired -- Adventures of a Simpler Life
feeds.description: Adventures of a Carolina-based retired teacher, Cynthia, who loves to travel at home and abroad. Reading, Snowshoeing, Cross Country Skiing, Hiking, Biking, and Living with Vintage Things are some of her other interests.

feeds.title: Retirement Travelers
feeds.description: John & Bev Martin of Retirement Travelers are traveling the world, sharing their adventures while hoping to inspire others to create their own experiences. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Passage For Two
feeds.description: Passage For Two is an adventure-of-a-lifetime travel blog featuring inspirational stories, amazing destinations, how-to advice and tips to inspire your nomadic wanderlust.

feeds.title: Kathleen Golden
feeds.description: A personalized Retirement blog featuring interviews, guests and travel guides for a creative and satisfying 'second act'. Share your story with Kathleen!

feeds.title: Bob and Jane's Excellent Adventure
feeds.description: After more than 30 years in education, Bob, & I sold our home in Big Rapids, Michigan, & all our belongings & have lived a nomadic lifestyle since New Years 2015. We've visited lots of Europe & the United States. Retirement allows us to travel at a slower pace enjoying subtleties of what we see. We don't consider ourselves tourists as much as temporary residents. We're having more fun than we ever imagined & meeting lots of interesting folks. I hope through my blog you'll travel along with us.

feeds.title: Retirednomad's Blog
feeds.description: Retired traveler indulging in choices & travel inexpensively.

feeds.title: The Simple Adventures Of Sue & Lee Ann » Travel
feeds.description: We are living a simple but happy retirement together. We enjoy travel, learning, laughing, fitness and a great-grandchild.

feeds.title: Joe and Josee's Journey
feeds.description: Just an ordinary couple living an extraordinary lifestyle! In 2014 we decided to sell everything we owned to embark on a Journey to discover the world. After a five year overland expedition through the Americas driving from Alaska to Argentina, we traded our truck for two backpacks... Let's see where the wind takes us this time!

feeds.title: Granny Gear
feeds.description: Conversations about Life and Travel after Retirement. Written by Nancy Coiner, Granny Gear's articles cover Retirement Issues, Travel Stories, Retirement Challenges & their Solutions, and how it is to being Retired.

feeds.title: Retirestyle Travel
feeds.description: Provides information and ideas about places to go and things to do for older travelers, gen x, baby boomers, senior citizens and retirees who live travel and who want to become snowbirds or retire abroad to the best places in the world.

feeds.title: Gr8 Travel Tips
feeds.description: Travel, Health & Fitness Blog For Baby Boomers. A travel blog I began back in 2012, sharing our family travel memories and experiences throughout the year. Offering International Travel Tips, Health & Fitness Inspiration For Mature Adults.

feeds.title: Root of Good
feeds.description: Covers blog posts on retirement, financial independence, parenting, personal finance, investing, money hacks, travel, DIY and lifestyle. Root of Good tells how the author managed to accumulate enough wealth to make him financially independent which allowed him to retire at age 33.
